official_sources.claim: COT reports ordinarily publish Friday at 15:30 ET from Tuesday positions; CFTC states historical data are not revised after publication.
Official annual compressed Traders in Financial Futures archives are available by report year.
Official exception log records delayed releases, shutdown schedules and corrections.
The 2024-12-31 report identifies BITCOIN - CHICAGO MERCANTILE EXCHANGE as CFTC market code 133741.
Official TFF field definitions enumerate positioning, changes, percentages and trader counts.

candidates.availability_rule: 00:00 UTC on the calendar day after the actual CFTC publication date. Use the official ordinary Friday schedule plus official Historical Special Announcements/holiday/shutdown overrides; any report whose actual release date cannot be reconstructed is ineligible. Never use the Tuesday observation date as availability.
candidates.approximate_volume: 3.77 MB compressed for official 2017-2024 TFF annual archives; 352 eligible Bitcoin rows from 2018-04-10 through 2024-12-31 before release-date admission.
candidates.acquisition_method: Download official fut_fin_txt_YYYY.zip annual archives, preserve exact bytes and SHA-256, select market code 133741, and construct a separate official release-calendar manifest.

pilot.retrieval_scope: Official annual TFF archives only; no BTC prices or outcomes were read.

official_sources.claim: GDELT 2.0 publishes Events, Mentions and GKG file families on a 15-minute cadence.
GDELT 2.0 timestamped file coverage begins 2015-02-19 and exposes master/last-update enumeration.
DATEADDED and MentionTimeDate identify GDELT processing/update batches in UTC.
GKGRECORDID begins with the UTC batch timestamp in which a record was created; document publication date is a different field.
The deterministic master list enumerates timestamped bulk objects, sizes and MD5 identities.

candidates.availability_rule: Batch timestamp plus 24 hours, using DATEADDED/MentionTimeDate/GKGRECORDID first-observation semantics. Never use a publisher-supplied document date as GDELT availability; preserve and hash the exact timestamped bulk object, and reject records lacking a valid processing-batch timestamp.
candidates.approximate_volume: Master list about 128 MB; naive 2017-2024 GKG acquisition is order 1-2 TiB compressed, while Events and Mentions are much smaller. Streamed source-time filtering is required.
candidates.acquisition_method: Enumerate masterfilelist.txt, pin size/MD5 plus local SHA-256, stream timestamped Events/Mentions/GKG ZIP members, and retain first-seen records with raw-object provenance.
blockers: Naive GKG retention is too large for the V1 local path.
Duplicate/follow-on mention rules and exact Bitcoin entity query must be frozen before acquisition.
A bounded streamed acquisition pilot is still required; the paused WP-009 Timeline API path must not be reused.

pilot.retrieval_scope: Representative timestamped bulk objects only; no BTC prices or outcomes were read.

official_sources.claim: CC-NEWS has daily WARC files from 2016 onward under date-addressed paths and is published shortly after articles are crawled.
WARC records preserve raw HTTP responses, WARC-Date capture timestamps and content digests.
Official monthly path manifests deterministically enumerate CC-NEWS WARC objects.
Official monthly path manifests continue through the scoped 2024-12 endpoint.

candidates.availability_rule: 00:00 UTC on the calendar day after max(WARC-Date, archived object Last-Modified). The WARC capture, not article metadata, is the information timestamp; preserve path, WARC record ID and payload/block digest and reject malformed timestamps.
candidates.approximate_volume: 41,292 monthly-enumerated WARC objects for 2017-08 through 2024-12, approximately 40.3 TiB compressed at roughly 1 GiB per object.
candidates.acquisition_method: Pin each monthly warc.paths.gz manifest and stream WARC response records; no official CC-NEWS URL index was established in this gate.
blockers: Full local scanning is tens of TiB compressed.
Common Crawl documents CDX access for main crawls, but this gate did not establish an equivalent official CC-NEWS index for selective URL retrieval.
Language, deduplication and Bitcoin relevance must be defined without a future-derived publisher list.

pilot.retrieval_scope: Monthly path manifests and object metadata only; no BTC prices or outcomes were read.

reason: It has official observation and release semantics, a fail-closed historical availability rule, stable market code 133741, compact annual archives, deterministic byte identities and information orthogonal to existing spot/order-flow features. Partial pre-2018 coverage is explicit and manageable by matched-universe design.

rejected_sources.reason: Not rejected scientifically, but deferred until a bounded streaming/deduplication foundation proves local cost and exact first-seen semantics.
Point-in-time semantics pass, but the scoped corpus is not locally feasible without a proven selective CC-NEWS index.

unresolved_questions: CFTC: enumerate every 2018-2024 non-Friday release and correction from official schedules before canonicalization.
CFTC: define treatment of absent holiday/shutdown reports and classification changes before any feature design.
GDELT: benchmark a deterministic streaming first-seen Bitcoin subset without the Timeline API.
Common Crawl: determine whether an official CC-NEWS capture index exists that avoids full WARC scanning.
